title: Maximum Distance in Arrays
goal: Solve Maximum Distance in Arrays: Find the maximum distance between two elements from different arrays, where distance is the absolute difference between elements from two different rows.
strategy: Find the maximum distance between two elements from different arrays, where distance is the absolute difference between elements from two different rows.
edgeCases: The two chosen values must come from different arrays; two extremes in one array are not an eligible pair.
inputRules: Input must be array of arrays
